text.tspan: Cereal yield vs. GDP per capita 2024
Average cereal yield, measured in tonnes per hectare versus gross domestic product (GDP) per capita. GDP per
capita is adjusted for inflation and differences in living costs between countries.
GDP per capita (international-$ in 2021 prices; plotted on a logarithmic axis)

tspan.tspan: Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO), via World Bank (2026); Eurostat, OECD, IMF, and World Bank
GDP per capita is expressed in international-$ at 2021 prices. Where data for 2024 is unavailable, the value from the closest year
